thread:
alex: Heads-up — planning to apply the networking + IAM TF changes tied to release v1.9.2 in tomorrow's 02:00 UTC change window. Deploybot already has the PR queued. Need confirmation on reserved IP assignment for the new peering gateway, provider pin, and rollback signal before we start.

sam: Looks good. I can own IP allocation check. Which CIDR pool are we pulling from?

alex: We'll use the infra-gateway-pool (10.40.0.0/20). Sam, please verify no overlapping allocations in staging/prod.

ops-erin: I'll take provider/version pinning and the escape hatch plan. Suggest we pin aws provider to 4.60.0 in the module root for the run: `provider = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.60"`. If anything fails, we abort and flip to fallback model (route53-only config).

jin: For rollback signal — agreed. Let's encode a simple flag in SSM parameter store `/infra/releases/v1.9.2/rollback` default `false`. If set to `true` the deploybot will stop further waves. ops-erin, can you add that to the playbook?

ops-erin: Yep. I'll add the check and the quick runbook: 1) set SSM param to true, 2) trigger `terraform apply -target=module.egress -refresh=false` revert to previous module ref, 3) notify infra-oncall.

sam: IP check done — staging has no overlap, prod spare block is free. I reserved 10.40.8.0/24 and pushed comment on the PR with the allocation. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Deploy queued: PR #1821 — plan created, awaiting `terraform apply` window at 2024-09-12T02:00:00Z. Locks: state-lock acquired for plan-stage. Canary policy: 10% traffic shift for 15m then 100% if green.

alex: Two small asks before we go: (1) add a preflight smoke test that hits internal health endpoints for the peering path, (2) include release notes bullet about the ephemeral IP change.

ops-erin: Added smoke test step to PR (script path: `infra/tests/peering_smoke.sh`). Release notes stub added under docs/releases/v1.9.2.md — please review.

jin: Also adding a quick-check to CI that verifies the SSM param exists and defaults false. Pushing now.

alex: Great. Last thing — if deploybot signals any drift > 2 resources, we abort and call the rollback playbook. Everyone ok?

sam: Agreed. I'll be on-call during the window to help with quick IP move if needed.

ops-erin: I'll watch deploybot logs and SSM. If anything, I have the KMS key to rotate access for emergency revert.

alex: Cool. If no objections, I'll set the PR to merge-on-window. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
